list.emptyChatsHint: + Chat to start an encrypted DM
list.emptyRoomsHint: + Room to create a token-gated community space
thread.selectHint: or start a new one from the left
thread.readOnly: Member posting is paused in Chat. Other clients may still send messages.
thread.joinToSend: Join this room to send messages.
thread.blockedNote: This conversation is blocked. Messages and receipts are hidden.
thread.requestNote: Message request. Accept to reply; no read receipts are sent before acceptance.
thread.acceptToSend: Accept or unblock this conversation to send messages.
settings.blockedHelp: Manage blocked conversations in Chats → Blocked. Blocking hides this direct conversation and stops your outgoing messages and receipts. It does not remove messages from shared rooms.
thread.receiptMeaning: The peer sent a read receipt at this time. It does not identify an exact message.
thread.adminPosting: Member posting is paused in Chat. Administrators can still post; other clients may ignore this policy.
settings.pictureHelp: Set your profile picture on ENS to show the same avatar across apps.
settings.walletIdentity: Connected wallet identity. ENS profile data appears when available.
settings.connectIdentity: Connect a wallet to use your address and ENS profile.
settings.walletConnectIdentity: Connect with WalletConnect to use your address and ENS profile.
settings.mockMessaging: Messaging runs locally in mock mode.
settings.connectMessaging: Connect a wallet above to enable encrypted messaging.
settings.messagingSignature: One-time signature to create your encrypted inbox. No gas, no transaction.
settings.resolverHint: Type a name to resolve its address, or an address to look up its ENS name.
settings.resolverInvalid: Enter a .eth name or a 0x address.
settings.resolverNoName: No primary ENS name found for this address.
settings.resolverError: ENS lookup unavailable. Try again later.
settings.receiptHelp: When on, Chat sends read receipts in direct chats. Turn off to stop sending receipts from this device. Previously sent receipts cannot be withdrawn.
settings.syncActive: On for this browser session, for up to 24 hours. Encrypted preferences are stored by the sync service.
settings.syncPaused: Paused after restart. Re-enable with your wallet to resume encrypted sync.
settings.syncOff: Off. Preferences stay on this device. Enable with two gas-free signatures; the device key stays in memory.
settings.mockMode: Mock mode: local chats on this device.
settings.xmtpMode: XMTP mode: encrypted DMs and rooms.
settings.orgHelp: Import an org config or create one. Chats stay inside the active org.
settings.revokeHelp: Revoke all current sync device authorizations if a device is lost or compromised. Each device will need fresh wallet authorization. Saved encrypted data is retained.
settings.footer: Direct messages use XMTP when enabled. Your profile picture comes from ENS. Preferences live on this device unless sync is on.
settings.revokeSignature: You'll be asked for one wallet signature to authorize the revoke.
settings.pictureSet: ✓ Picture set on ENS — {name}. Shown across apps.
settings.notResolved: {name} does not currently resolve to an address.
settings.revokeLimit: Your messaging inbox is at XMTP's limit of 10 devices/sessions. To enable messaging on this device, Chat will revoke the existing installations on your inbox.
settings.revokeEffect: This signs you out of messaging on every other device and browser. Local data is not erased, but those installations can no longer provide history until reconnected. Before revoking, keep the old browser data and verify a working history source or backup. Reconnecting alone does not guarantee older messages will return.
update.unsupported: In-app updates run in the desktop app. The web app updates on reload; iOS updates via the App Store.
update.idle: Up to date as far as we know — check for a new version.
update.title: Software update
status.syncEnabled: Encrypted sync is enabled for this browser session, for up to 24 hours.
status.syncRevoked: Sync is off and this device authorization was revoked.
status.syncLocalOff: Sync is off locally. Use Revoke all sync devices to revoke earlier sessions.
status.syncAllRevoked: All existing sync device authorizations were revoked. Your encrypted saved data is retained.
status.syncChanged: Settings changed while syncing. Your local choices are saved; enable sync again to retry.
status.syncFailed: Sync failed. Local changes are saved on this device; retry sync when available.
status.syncUnreadable: Remote sync could not be read. Local data is unchanged.
status.syncExpired: Sync authorization expired. Re-enable sync with your wallet.
status.syncConnect: Connect a wallet before enabling encrypted sync.
status.syncConflict: Another device changed sync again. Try enabling sync again.
status.syncUnsaved: Encrypted sync was not saved. Try again; local data has been kept.
status.syncUndecryptable: Encrypted sync could not be decrypted. Remote data has been preserved.
status.revokeUnconfirmed: Sync stopped locally; revocation was not confirmed.
status.revokeConnect: Connect a wallet to revoke sync devices.
status.revokeRetry: Revocation was not confirmed. Retry when connected.
status.keyRejected: Wallet signature was rejected or unavailable. Sync stayed off.
status.walletChanged: Wallet changed. Re-enable sync for the current wallet.
status.accountChanged: Wallet account changed. Reconnect before enabling sync.
status.authChanged: Wallet account changed. Reconnect before authorizing sync.
status.walletMissing: No wallet provider is connected. Connect a wallet, then try again.
status.authConnect: Connect a wallet before authorizing sync.
status.accountMissing: Wallet did not return an account.
status.signatureMissing: Wallet did not return a signature.
status.walletInjectedMissing: No injected wallet was found. Local identity mode is still available.
status.syncReadFailed: Unable to read encrypted sync. Try again when storage is available.
status.syncWrongService: Sync service authorization is unavailable or has the wrong origin.
status.revokeServerUnconfirmed: Sync stopped locally, but server revocation was not confirmed. Revoke all sync devices when connected.
settings.orgStorageError: Organization changes could not be saved or loaded. Check browser storage access before closing this page.
settings.orgRecoveryHelp: Some saved organization data could not be loaded. Valid organizations remain available, and the original data has been retained for recovery.
dialog.supported: Supported on Ethereum mainnet: token holdings with an explicit ERC-1155 token ID, Safe owners, and ENS. Role, voting-power and Safe-delegate gates are unavailable.
dialog.policyHelp: Posting and attachment policies apply in Chat. Other clients can ignore them; they do not remove members or erase message history.
dialog.gatekeeperHelp: Gated rooms need an external gatekeeper. After creation, publish the room ID in the gatekeeper registry so other members can discover and join it.
dialog.accessHelp: Who may join. Multiple rules combine by the mode below.
dialog.overrideHelp: (what may happen — overrides the org default)
dialog.name: Name
dialog.gateUrlHelp: Production gated rooms need a configured external gate. Blank uses this app's /api/room-join.
dialog.themeHelp: (optional — re-skins the app for this org)
dialog.presetHelp: Example configurations for the two Bittrees apps. Illustrative contracts must be verified before use.
dialog.configHelp: Paste an exported organization, or pick a preset above.
status.importLimit: Organization config exceeds the 256 KB import limit.
status.orgLimitReached: Organization limit reached. Remove an organization before adding another.
status.orgStorageUnreadable: Organization storage could not be read. Restore access before importing or creating an organization.
thread.descriptionLimit: Room descriptions must be 10,000 characters or fewer.
thread.invalidRoom: Room configuration is invalid or unsupported. Ask an administrator to repair it.
status.xmtpDisabled: XMTP messaging is not enabled yet.
status.inboxNotReady: XMTP inbox is not ready yet.
status.xmtpConnect: Connect a wallet to enable XMTP.
status.revokeInstallations: Connect a wallet to revoke installations.
status.unsupportedGate: This room uses an unsupported production gate.
status.gateDenied: This wallet does not satisfy the room gate.
status.directoryUnavailable: Published rooms are unavailable. Try again shortly.
status.replyUnloaded: Reply target is not loaded yet.
status.reactionUnloaded: Reaction target is not loaded yet.
status.reactionUnavailable: Reaction target is no longer available.
status.consentRequired: Accept or unblock this conversation before sending messages or reactions.
status.consentDirect: Consent controls apply to direct messages.
status.peerDisabled: That address hasn't activated XMTP messaging yet.
status.gateSetup: Gated rooms need an external gate service and gatekeeper address. Ask your organization administrator to configure them first.
status.gateRules: Production gates currently support mainnet token rules (explicit ERC-1155 IDs), Safe owners, and ENS. Check the rule and a positive minimum.
status.gatekeeperDisabled: Gatekeeper wallet has not activated XMTP messaging yet.
status.roomMissing: Room not found in this organization.
status.externalGate: Connect a wallet and configure the organization's external gate.
status.roomUnpublished: The gate could not authorize this room. Ask an administrator to publish it in the room registry.
status.joinSignature: Wallet did not return a join signature.
status.joinsUnavailable: Self-serve joins are not configured. Ask a room admin to add you.
status.acceptSend: Accept or unblock this conversation before sending.
status.acceptReact: Accept or unblock this conversation before reacting.
status.joinsMock: Self-serve gated joins are only available with XMTP transport.
status.sendFailed: Message was not sent. Your draft is saved; try again.
status.reconnecting: Messaging is reconnecting. Try again shortly.
status.joinApproved: Join request approved. Syncing room membership.
routing.recipientHint: Wallet address, name.eth, or email address
routing.walletNotice: Wallet chats use Chat. Opening a chat does not send a message.
routing.emailNotice: Email addresses open your email app. You choose the sending email account there. Email replies stay in that app; Chat does not sync your mailbox. A configured email app is required.
routing.title: Messaging channels
routing.intro: Use wallet messaging on its own or alongside your email app. Choose the destination when starting a message.
routing.walletDescription: Connect your wallet and enable messaging for encrypted direct chats. New contacts arrive as requests that you can accept or block.
routing.shareHint: Share this link in an email or on your profile. It reveals your wallet address. Visitors must connect and confirm the recipient; it does not forward email.
routing.enableHint: Enable wallet messaging to create your invitation link.
routing.bridgeNotice: Automatic forwarding requires a configured bridge and verified, opted-in email and wallet identities. Typing an email address never looks up or exposes someone’s wallet.
routing.bridgePrivacy: A bridge can read the messages it forwards. Email delivery is not end-to-end encrypted wallet chat. No messages are automatically forwarded between these channels.
mail.title: Wallet → email
mail.notice: Authorize an email with your connected wallet. The service sends from its own address and can read the content. Replies are not forwarded to your wallet.
mail.disabled: Forwarding is not activated on this service yet.
mail.pilot: Pilot: only approved sending wallets and recipients with verified, correspondent-specific consent can send. Text only, up to 16 KiB.
mail.connect: Connect your wallet in Settings to authorize email.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.receiptHint: Keep this ID to check the result after reopening Chat. If the connection fails, check or retry this same request before starting another.
mail.status.sending: A delivery attempt is in progress.
mail.status.accepted: The email provider accepted this message. This does not confirm delivery or reading.
mail.status.stopped: Forwarding stopped. The message may have been accepted during an interrupted attempt; contact support before resending.
mail.status.denied: This wallet and recipient are not authorized for forwarding.
mail.status.limited: The forwarding limit has been reached.
mail.status.conflict: This request ID belongs to a different message. Check its status.
mail.status.unknown: No queued request was found for this wallet and ID.
mail.status.uncertain: The result is unknown. Keep the request ID; check its status or retry the same request before composing another message.
status.walletConnectAccountMissing: WalletConnect did not provide a wallet account. Reconnect and try again.
status.revokeRefresh: Revocation was not confirmed. Refresh and retry.
status.syncOriginInvalid: This build needs a valid secure sync service address. Contact your administrator.
status.syncOriginMissing: Sync is not configured for this app. Contact your administrator.
status.syncWriteFailed: Sync could not be saved. Please try again.
status.syncWriteConflict: Sync changed while saving. Please try again.
status.ensFailed: The ENS name could not be looked up. Please try again.
settings.historyRecoveryHelp: Moving to this browser or device? Keep Chat open and messaging enabled on your old device or at chirpy.bittrees.org, using the same wallet. Then request your XMTP message history here. This does not transfer local settings or Push rooms.
settings.historyRequested: History requested. Keep your old session open while messages and conversation consent sync. A request does not confirm that all history has arrived; check your conversations before leaving the old session.
settings.historyFailed: The history request could not be confirmed. Check your connection and connected wallet, then try again. Existing messages are unchanged.
recovery.settingsScope: Exports contacts, local notes, receipt preferences and legacy blocked-address preferences for this wallet in this browser. Message history, organizations and keys are not included. Use Restore local data to review a recovery file; keep the old browser until all data is verified.
recovery.passwordHelp: Choose a unique passphrase of at least 12 characters. Keep it separately from the file; Chat cannot reset it. You will sign a one-time wallet ownership check before export.
recovery.prepared: Encrypted file prepared. Check your downloads and keep the passphrase separately. No existing data was changed.
recovery.failed: No recovery file was prepared. Check your connected wallet and browser storage, approve the ownership signature and try again without changing settings, contacts or notes. Contract wallets require Ethereum mainnet.
local.contactsHelp: Save wallet addresses with private labels for composing messages. Labels are visible only to you and do not change anyone’s public profile.
local.notesHelp: Write notes for this wallet in this browser. Saved Messages conversations remain separate.
local.storageHelp: Stored only in this browser, without encryption at rest. Not synced. Use the encrypted local-data export in Settings to keep a copy. Clearing browser data removes these items.
local.connect: Connect your wallet in Settings to use contacts and local notes.
local.readError: Could not read local data. Existing records have not been replaced. Retry or reopen the browser; do not clear its data.
local.writeError: Could not save this change. Your input is still here. Check browser storage and retry.
local.conflictError: This item changed in another session or already exists. Your input is still here. Review the current item before editing again.
local.label: Private contact label
local.deleteConfirm: Delete this local item? This cannot be undone.
settings.storageError: Settings could not be saved or safely read. Existing browser data was kept. Use an up-to-date browser with working local storage, resolve any unfinished restore, then reload. Export and sync are paused.
status.syncOffUnsaved: Sync stopped for this session, but the local preference could not be saved. Restore browser storage before reloading.
status.syncRevokedUnsaved: Sync authorizations were revoked, but the local preference could not be saved. Restore browser storage before reloading.
restore.title: Restore local data
restore.help: Choose an encrypted Chat recovery file for this wallet. Review changes before applying them. This restores local application data, not message history, keys, memberships or email access. Reload other open Chat tabs before restoring.
restore.failed: Recovery could not be completed. Check the file, passphrase, connected wallet and browser storage. If changes are pending, resume or undo below. A later edit will not be overwritten; download the backup for a separate review. Keep this browser’s data.
restore.applied: Reviewed changes saved. The pre-restore backup is retained. Sync stays off until you enable it again.
restore.undone: Restore undone. Previous local data and preferences are back; sync remains off.
restore.downloaded: Encrypted backup prepared. Check your downloads and keep the passphrase separately.
restore.pending: An unfinished restore needs attention. Local edits are paused. Resume it or undo it before making more changes. Do not clear browser data.
restore.backupHeld: A pre-restore backup is stored in this browser, without encryption at rest. Keep it until you verify the result. Download it before discarding it; another import requires resolving this backup first.
restore.undoConfirm: Restore the pre-import data and preferences? This only proceeds if no later edits would be overwritten. Sync will remain off.
restore.backupExport: Save an encrypted copy of the pre-restore backup
restore.backupHelp: Choose a new passphrase of at least 12 characters and keep it separately. You will verify this wallet before downloading.
restore.discardConfirm: Permanently discard the pre-restore backup? Save an encrypted copy first if you may need it. Current contacts, notes and preferences will stay as they are.
restore.sourceWarning: This label is not proof of who created the file.
restore.inspectFile: Inspect contacts and notes in this file
restore.conflictsHelp: Existing values are kept when an address or note ID conflicts. Expand each conflict to review it and explicitly choose a replacement. Missing entries are never deleted.
restore.receipts: Apply receipt preferences from this file; this may enable sharing read receipts
restore.blocks: Add legacy blocked-address preferences from this file
restore.blocksHelp: Existing addresses are retained. These legacy preferences do not change XMTP or Push conversation consent; review protocol blocking in your conversations separately.
restore.limit: The combined data exceeds the supported recovery limits. No data was truncated. Keep the source file and use a smaller recovery file.
restore.noChanges: No changes are selected. Existing entries and preferences will be kept.
restore.applyHelp: Applying requires a fresh wallet check. A local backup is saved first and sync is paused. Keep the original file and the old browser until you have checked your data.
restore.abandon: Keep current data and stop restore
restore.abandonConfirm: Stop this unfinished restore and keep the data currently in this browser, even if only some reviewed changes were applied? The pre-restore backup will remain available for download. This does not complete the import.
restore.abandoned: Restore stopped with current data kept. The import is not marked complete. The pre-restore backup is still available; sync in this session remains paused.
restore.paused: Local-data recovery has paused receipt sharing, settings edits and sync. Open Settings to finish or undo it.
push.provenance: Messages come from Push. Public history is not encrypted; this view does not independently verify public-message signatures or confirm delivery or reading.
push.cannotSend: Sending requires a connected Push wallet and current room permission.
